$comment: Frame budgets for the shape-actors stage (Dunyati worlds). Engine and recording times are measured on the runner and projected onto each device class by its CPU slowdown (scripts/perf/scenarios.ts DEVICES): projected = measured p95 x slowdown. A 60 Hz frame is 16.7 ms; the JS share (engine + Skia recording) must leave room for React, gestures and the bridge. Node and web rows are gated against perf-baseline.json (ratchet: a regression fails); absolute projections are gated with --strict. Web because a shared VM without a GPU cannot prove absolute 60 fps; their absolute targets are reported, not gated, unless --strict.
